    2   #=============================================================================
    3   # Animates the battle intro
    4   #=============================================================================
    5   def pbBattleIntroAnimation
    6     # Make everything appear
    7     introAnim = Animation::Intro.new(@sprites, @viewport, @battle)
    8     loop do
    9       introAnim.update
   10       pbUpdate
   11       break if introAnim.animDone?
   12     end
   13     introAnim.dispose
   14     # Post-appearance activities
   15     # Trainer battle: get ready to show the party lineups (they are brought
   16     # on-screen by a separate animation)
   17     if @battle.trainerBattle?
   18       # NOTE: Here is where you'd make trainer sprites animate if they had an
   19       #       entrance animation. Be sure to set it up like a Pokémon entrance
   20       #       animation, i.e. add them to @animations so that they can play out
   21       #       while party lineups appear and messages show.
   22       pbShowPartyLineup(0, true)
   23       pbShowPartyLineup(1, true)
   24       return
   25     end
   26     # Wild battle: play wild Pokémon's intro animations (including cry), show
   27     # data box(es), return the wild Pokémon's sprite(s) to normal colour, show
   28     # shiny animation(s)
   29     # Set up data box animation
   30     @battle.sideSizes[1].times do |i|
   31       idxBattler = (2 * i) + 1
   32       next if !@battle.battlers[idxBattler]
   33       dataBoxAnim = Animation::DataBoxAppear.new(@sprites, @viewport, idxBattler)
   34       @animations.push(dataBoxAnim)
   35     end
   36     # Set up wild Pokémon returning to normal colour and playing intro
   37     # animations (including cry)
   38     @animations.push(Animation::Intro2.new(@sprites, @viewport, @battle.sideSizes[1]))
   39     # Play all the animations
   40     while inPartyAnimation?
   41       pbUpdate
   42     end
   43     # Show shiny animation for wild Pokémon
   44     if @battle.showAnims
   45       @battle.sideSizes[1].times do |i|
   46         idxBattler = (2 * i) + 1
   47         next if !@battle.battlers[idxBattler] || !@battle.battlers[idxBattler].shiny?
   48         if Settings::SUPER_SHINY && @battle.battlers[idxBattler].super_shiny?
   49           pbCommonAnimation("SuperShiny", @battle.battlers[idxBattler])
   50         else
   51           pbCommonAnimation("Shiny", @battle.battlers[idxBattler])
   52         end
   53       end
   54     end
   55   end

   57   #=============================================================================
   58   # Animates a party lineup appearing for the given side
   59   #=============================================================================
   60   def pbShowPartyLineup(side, fullAnim = false)
   61     @animations.push(
   62       Animation::LineupAppear.new(@sprites, @viewport, side,
   63                                   @battle.pbParty(side), @battle.pbPartyStarts(side),
   64                                   fullAnim)
   65     )
   66     return if fullAnim
   67     while inPartyAnimation?
   68       pbUpdate
   69     end
   70   end
